decisions.reason: As a new safety-shoe line in the firm’s core business, with no clear sign of performance below aspiration and enough organisational slack in a large incumbent, it would be retained for further market learning.
The comfort insole is a close complement to the established footwear range, and without evidence of a clear shortfall the firm would keep it while assessing whether adoption builds over time.

The supportive insole uses existing product-development and sales capabilities and, given the absence of clear underperformance information, a large firm would likely continue it rather than cut it after only one year.
Its dedicated product page suggests strategic emphasis and early salience, so management would likely judge the ergonomic safety-shoe series worth continuing within its innovation agenda.
Firefighter and rescue boots fit the company’s protective-footwear expertise and likely serve a specialist niche, so with no clear evidence of results below aspiration the product would be kept.

Being featured on the home page indicates notable commercial or strategic importance, and under bounded rationality the firm would continue this moulded insole while gathering more performance feedback.
